description: This file contains command-line interface (CLI) commands for managing models in a LiteLLM proxy server, including listing, adding, deleting, retrieving, updating, and importing models, with data formatting and filtering functionalities.

classes.name: ModelYamlInfo
classes.description: Dataclass representing model information loaded from YAML, including name, parameters, info, ID, access groups, and provider.

methods.name: _get_model_info_obj_from_yaml
methods.description: Extracts model info from a dictionary and returns a ModelYamlInfo object.

methods.name: format_iso_datetime_str
methods.description: Converts an ISO datetime string to a human-readable format.

methods.name: format_timestamp
methods.description: Converts a Unix timestamp to a human-readable date string.

methods.name: format_cost_per_1k_tokens
methods.description: Formats a cost value per 1000 tokens into a dollar string.

methods.name: create_client
methods.description: Creates a Client instance from the CLI context.

methods.name: list_models
methods.description: Lists all available models, displaying in table or JSON format.

methods.name: add_model
methods.description: Adds a new model to the proxy with specified parameters and info.

methods.name: delete_model
methods.description: Deletes a model from the proxy by ID.

methods.name: get_model
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific model by ID or name.

methods.name: get_models_info
methods.description: Displays detailed information about all models with customizable columns.

methods.name: update_model
methods.description: Updates an existing model's parameters and info.

methods.name: _filter_model
methods.description: Filters models based on regex matching for model ID and access groups.

methods.name: _print_models_table
methods.description: Prints a table of models with name, ID, and access groups.

methods.name: _print_summary_table
methods.description: Prints a summary table of provider counts.

methods.name: get_model_list_from_yaml_file
methods.description: Loads and validates a list of models from a YAML file.

methods.name: _get_filtered_model_list
methods.description: Filters a list of models based on regex criteria.

methods.name: _import_models_get_table_title
methods.description: Returns the table title string based on dry-run status.

methods.name: import_models
methods.description: Imports models from a YAML file into the proxy, with optional filtering and dry-run.
